contactShadow.Name: Contact shadow
contactShadow.Hint: A soft shadow under every token.

hover.Name: Bob while flying
hover.Hint: Flying creatures gently bob above their shadow.

jump.Name: Jump arc
jump.Hint: A token that moves by jumping follows an arc above its shadow.

perspective.Name: Elevation perspective
perspective.Hint: A token lower than yours looks smaller; a higher one looks larger, and turns semi-transparent when it covers another token.

lightShadows.Name: Light-cast shadows
lightShadows.Hint: The two strongest lights on a token cast its shadow away from them.

contactSize.Name: Contact shadow size
contactSize.Hint: Shadow diameter relative to the token (1 = same width; above 1 it shows around the image, needed for an opaque round portrait).

contactOpacity.Name: Contact shadow opacity
contactOpacity.Hint: 0 = invisible, 1 = solid black at the centre.

hoverLift.Name: Flight height
hoverLift.Hint: Gap between a flying token and its shadow, as a fraction of its height.

hoverAmplitude.Name: Hover amplitude
hoverAmplitude.Hint: Size of the bobbing, as a fraction of the token height (0 = still).

jumpHeight.Name: Jump height
jumpHeight.Hint: Height of the top of the arc, as a fraction of the jump's length (between 0.3 and 1.25 squares).

elevationLift.Name: Maximum elevation offset
elevationLift.Hint: Largest gap, in grid squares, between a raised token and its shadow (reached around 35 ft on a 5 ft grid).

perspectiveMax.Name: Maximum size change
perspectiveMax.Hint: A token higher than yours grows, a lower one shrinks, by at most this fraction (0.2 → between 80% and 120%).

fadeAlpha.Name: Opacity of a token covering another
fadeAlpha.Hint: A token higher than yours that covers a lower token fades to this opacity; it turns opaque again on hover or when you control it.

castIntensity.Name: Light-cast shadow intensity
castIntensity.Hint: Opacity of shadows cast by lights (0 = none, 1 = solid black under bright light).

lightHeight.Name: Light height (ft)
lightHeight.Hint: Height of a light above its elevation. The lower it is, the longer the shadows. Can be overridden per light with the dnd5e-lumiere.height flag.

darkvisionBlur.Name: Blur beyond Darkvision
darkvisionBlur.Hint: Beyond your tokens' Darkvision range, Dim Light (Lightly Obscured) is slightly blurred; Bright Light stays sharp. The grey within range is Foundry's own.

darkvisionBlurStrength.Name: Blur strength (Darkvision)
darkvisionBlurStrength.Hint: Blur radius in screen pixels (0 = none).

castFlicker.Name: Shadow flicker under flames
castFlicker.Hint: Under an animated flame light (fire, torch), cast shadows flicker with the flame: paler and slightly longer when it dips (0 = still, 1 = default).

sunShadows.Name: Sun shadows
sunShadows.Hint: When the scene's Global Illumination is on (Scene configuration, Visibility tab), the sun casts token shadows according to world time: long at sunrise and sunset, short at noon. Uses dawn and dusk from Simple Timekeeping & Calendar when it is active (per month, or from its latitude and season), otherwise sunrise at 6:00 and sunset at 18:00. Can be turned off per scene (Scene configuration, Environment tab).

sunAltitude.Name: Sun height at noon (°)
sunAltitude.Hint: The lower it is, the longer the noon shadows.

levelTransition.Name: Level change transition (alpha)
levelTransition.Hint: When the view moves to another level of the same scene, a depth effect: going up, the level you leave shrinks and fades away below while the new one settles from above the screen; going down, the reverse. Only what your tokens see is shown. Experimental.

levelTransitionDuration.Name: Level change transition duration (ms)
levelTransitionDuration.Hint: Length of the depth effect when changing level.

etherealView.Name: View from the Ethereal Plane
etherealView.Hint: When a token you look from is Ethereal (dnd5e's Ethereal condition), the Material Plane turns monochrome, blurred and misty grey; Ethereal creatures stand out, sharp, in their own colours, with a faint bluish halo.

etherealBlur.Name: Ethereal Plane: blur of the Material Plane
etherealBlur.Hint: Blur radius in screen pixels (0 = none).

etherealMist.Name: Ethereal Plane: mist
etherealMist.Hint: How much bluish-grey mist covers the Material Plane (0 = plain grey).

etherealHalo.Name: Ethereal Plane: halo opacity
etherealHalo.Hint: Halo around Ethereal creatures seen from the Ethereal Plane (0 = no halo).

etherealHaloColor.Name: Ethereal Plane: halo colour
etherealHaloColor.Hint: Colour of the halo around Ethereal creatures.

LightConfig.HeightHint: Height above the light's elevation, used for Shadows & Ambience cast shadows. The lower it is, the longer the shadows. Empty: world setting ({default}).

TileConfig.RoofHint: Shadows & Ambience: this tile (a roof drawn with its façade, as on DM Andy's maps) is always shown, even through walls and the fog of war, lit and under the weather as when seen. It no longer fades under the mouse; it still fades when a token goes under it (use Fade occlusion above, not Surface). Purely visual: it reveals nothing beneath it.

SceneConfig.SunHint: Uncheck for an interior lit by Global Illumination: the sun casts no shadows there.
SceneConfig.NorthHint: Where north points, clockwise from the top of the map (0 = up, 90 = right). The sun rises in the east and is due south at noon.

Transitions.Title: Scene transitions

Menu.Name: Scene transitions
Menu.Label: Transitions
Menu.Hint: Custom scene transitions (ink…), a world-wide transition for every scene, and import / export of transition configuration files (JSON).

Transitions.GlobalHint: Played when anyone enters a scene that has no transition of its own (Scene configuration, Basics tab).
Transitions.ActiveOnly: Only when the scene is activated
Transitions.ActiveOnlyHint: Not when a GM merely views another scene.
Transitions.OverrideHint: Also played in scenes that have their own transition.
Transitions.Name: Name
Transitions.ImportHint: A transition file only holds parameters of a built-in effect (no code): export a built-in transition to get a template, change its id, label and params, then import it. Same id = replaced.
Transitions.RemoveConfirm: Delete the imported transition "{id}"? Scenes using it will fall back to Foundry's fade.
Transitions.BadJson: This file is not valid JSON: {error}
Transitions.ImportErrors: {count} error(s) in the file (see the console). First: {first}
Transitions.ImportDone: Transitions imported: {added} added, {replaced} replaced ({warnings} warning(s), see the console).
